title: Top 5 ways to get Claude Code to stop doing dumb stuff
description: Five ways to get Claude Code to actually behave: stop repeating mistakes, set guardrails, use CLAUDE.md properly, scope your agent permissions, and add memory. The difference between a useful agent and one that burns your API budget doing nothing.
